stories.title: Smotherman Wins Bermuda Championship Playoff — Back-to-Back PGA Tour Titles in October

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
TWO wins in ONE month.

Austin Smotherman defeats Seamus Power on the 3rd playoff hole to win the Butterfield Bermuda Championship.

His second PGA Tour title in less than 30 days. 🏆

#GolfFanrecap #BermudaChampionship

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Smotherman at Port Royal:
→ 16-under par (197)
→ Won on 3rd playoff hole vs. Power
→ $1,080,000 earned
→ 500 FedExCup points
→ Back-to-back PGA Tour wins in October

The fall swing just got a new star. #GolfFanrecap

article.headline: Austin Smotherman Wins Butterfield Bermuda Championship in Playoff Over Seamus Power

stories.title: Yuri Yoshida Claims First LPGA Title at BMW Ladies Championship in South Korea

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
FIRST CAREER LPGA TITLE. 🏆

Yuri Yoshida of Japan wins the BMW Ladies Championship at Pine Beach Golf Links in South Korea, defeating Haeran Ryu and Hye-Jin Choi.

A breakthrough moment in Korea. #GolfFanrecap #LPGATour
